name: Norcia (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Norcia (a white lion rampant on red) within branches, with a motto scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Norcia, a comune in Umbria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Norcia arms — white lion rampant on red, crowned, within branches, with motto scroll
